title: test_admin_login_with_valid_and_invalid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /auth/admin-login authenticates admin with valid credentials returning 200 and sets access_token cookie, rejects invalid credentials with 401, and returns 500 if admin credentials are not configured.

title: test_admin_logout_clears_session_cookie
description: Verify that POST /auth/logout clears the admin JWT cookie and returns 200 response.

title: test_check_vehicle_registration_availability
description: Verify that GET /users/check-vehicle returns 200 with availability status for available and already registered vehicle registration numbers.

title: test_user_registration_with_valid_and_invalid_data
description: Verify that POST /users/register accepts valid KYC payload with multiple documents and stores them in S3 returning 200, and rejects invalid file types or malformed data with 400 error.

title: test_admin_search_users_with_and_without_authentication
description: Verify that GET /admin/search returns 200 with paginated user results when called with valid admin cookie, and returns 401 Unauthorized when called without authentication.

title: test_admin_get_user_detail_and_handle_nonexistent_user
description: Verify that GET /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no} returns 200 with user details and presigned document links for existing users, and 404 for non-existent vehicle registration numbers.

title: test_admin_create_user_profile
description: Verify that POST /admin/user/create creates a new user profile with valid admin cookie and required data, returning 200 StatusResponse.

title: test_admin_upload_new_document_version
description: Verify that POST /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no}/upload uploads a new document version with valid admin cookie and returns 200, and the new version is available in version history.

title: test_admin_verify_or_reject_document_version
description: Verify that POST /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no}/documents/{doc_id}/verify accepts verification decision and reason, returning 200 VerificationResponse confirming approved or rejected status.

title: test_admin_retention_cleanup_dry_run_and_execute_modes
description: Verify that POST /admin/retention/cleanup with valid admin cookie and dry-run mode returns 200 with documents eligible for purge without deleting, and with execute mode and confirmation header permanently removes expired documents returning 200.
